name: Tattoos
overview: Scripture instructs believers to honor God with their bodies, warning against making marks or cuttings on the flesh as seen in Leviticus 19:28 and Deuteronomy 14:1, which prohibit such practices associated with mourning the dead. These commands emphasize the sanctity of the body as God's creation, a principle reinforced by Romans 1:24, which speaks against dishonoring one's body. Believers are called to discern what is acceptable to the Lord (Ephesians 5:10) and to live with an awareness of life's brevity (James 4:14), encouraging thoughtful stewardship of the body in a world where love can grow cold due to increasing iniquity (Matthew 24:12).
